title: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
title_zh: MemFolder：面向高效智能体记忆管理的结构引导式记忆折叠
abstract_en: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.
abstract_zh: 长期运行的智能体会不断积累外部记忆：记录越多，检索开销越高；检索返回的上下文越长，预填充（prefill）和解码阶段的注意力计算成本也越高。现有方法中，剪枝可能丢失有用证据，合并则可能让检索单元变少但变长。MemFolder 利用跨记录结构，先减少记录数量，再缩短上下文。两个组件共享同一套记忆分组：RecordFolder 对齐实体提及，逐步选出有代表性且互补的锚点，结合语义相似性、实体关联和时间顺序，将兼容记录整合为更少的检索单元；ContextFolder 将组内原始记录编码为紧凑文本，并在验证发现关键事实无法恢复时修订编码。实验覆盖三个文本记忆基准 LoCoMo、PersonaMem 和 LongMemEval，以及两个多模态基准 M3-Bench-web 和 M3-Bench-robot。在 Mem0 上，RecordFolder 将记录数减半，同时保留三个文本基准上原有平均性能的 99.0%，性能保留率比最强基线高 1.9 个百分点。ContextFolder 还可接入现有记录压缩方法，进一步缩短其输出，同时保留大部分性能。
key_points_zh: MemFolder 分两步处理不同的效率瓶颈：减少检索单元数量，再缩短检索返回的上下文。
RecordFolder 选择有代表性且互补的锚点，结合语义、实体和时间关系合并兼容记录。
ContextFolder 复用记忆分组压缩原始记录，并通过事实恢复验证发现遗漏、修订编码。
实验覆盖三个文本和两个多模态基准；在 Mem0 的三个文本基准上，记录减半后仍保留 99.0% 的原有平均性能，比最强基线高 1.9 个百分点。
